newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakura Bank shares fall by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: Sakura Bank shares fall by daily limit.

text.p: Sakura Bank Ltd shares fell by their daily limit on Thursday, pushed down by selling from foreign securities houses, brokers said.
The bank's share price closed 100 yen lower at 699 yen, making it the third sharpest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Brokers said shares of some city banks were targeted for selling by foreign investors and that the sales were somewhat speculative.

Banking sector shares have faltered recently, as Japanese firms have sold some of their banks' shareholdings to take profits ahead of the financial year-end book closings at the end of March, brokers said.
